'dus byas kyi 'khor ba zhes brjod par bya'o①/ /zag pa dang bcas pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa dag gis mngon par 'dus ma byas pa'i phyir na 'dus ma ②byas pa dang mya ngan las 'das pa zhes bya'o/ /de ltar bcom ldan 'das 'dus byas pa'i 'khor ba yang mchis/ 'dus ma ②byas pa dang 'dus ma byas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa yang mchis zhes gsungs so/ /pha rol tu phyin pa las kyang byams pa las dang nyon mongs pas nye bar 'gro ba'i skye bor mi brjod kyi 'on kyang dgra bcom pa rnams la bsam gyis mi khyab pa yongs su bsngo ba'i skye bor brjod par bya'o zhes gsungs so/ /bdag tu chags pa dang ldan pa rnams la sdug bsngal dang bde ba dag 'dod pa dang / thob par 'dod pas ①mngon par dga' ba sngon du 'gro ba can gyi mngal gyi ⑤gnas yongs su 'dzin pa yin pas nyon mongs pa rnams la khams gsum du skye ba'i nus pa yod pa yin no/ /de rnams log pas 'bras bu khams gsum du skye ba yang ldog pa yin gyi/ zag pa med pa'i khams su skye ba ni ldog pa ma yin no/ /lang kur gshegs pa las kyang /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi mtshan nyid la mngon par zhen pa'i dbang gis 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bying bar 'gyur ba dang / ma rig pa'i gnas pa'i 'ching bas gcig tu nges par mya ngan las mi 'da' ba dang / rnam par grol ba med pa dang / nyon mongs pa tsam las grol ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa med du zin kyang mar me shi ba bzhin du mya ngan las 'das ⑦snyam pa'i 'du shes can la zag pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pa'i zag pa med pa'i khams su sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par bskal pa ji snyed par pad+ma'i snying por gnas pa yin la de nas snang ba mtha' yas la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs 67—883

pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs nas 'od zer gyis sad ①par byas te/ ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'jig rten las 'das pa'i ②rab tu 'byor pa mthong nas byang chub kyi sems bskyed ①de/ skye ba la dbang thob pa'i stobs kyis mi g.yo ba la sogs pa'i sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams bsams bzhin du skye ba rnams kyis dmyal bar rgyu ba bzhin du/ 'gro bar 'gro zhes byang chub mchog thob par 'gyur ro zhes shin tu gsal bar gsungs so/ /des na theg pa gcig yin gyi gsum du gsungs pa ni dgongs pa can yin no zhes bya ba 'di gnas pa yin no/ /mdo kun las btus pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa la mdo kun las btus pa ni slob nga/pon klu sgrub zhabs kyis mdzad pa'o/ /sogs pa'i sgras ni mdo rnams bsdu bar bya'o/ /mngon par byang chub pa'i dus dang zhes bya ba ni dus gang gi tshe chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa mngon du mdzad pas so/ /bzhugs pa'i dus zhes bya ba ni dus ji srid du bzhugs so/ /de nyid bstan par bya ba'i phyir / bde bar gshegs pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ de la zhing de ①sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams la rdul phra rab ji snyed yod pa/ byang chub mchog rab dam par gshegs pa'i bskal pa de/ /zhes sbyar bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi yul lo/ /ma lus phyogs zhes bya ba ni phyogs bcu na'o/ /'di yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi sku nyid gcig yin pas de ltar brjod pa yin gyi/ gzhan du na sangs rgyas gzhan du 'byung bar mi 'gyur bas so/ /de nyid kyi phyir/ khyod kyi gsang ba 'di ni bsnyad pa ma lags so/ /zhes bya ba ⑤gsungs te/ 'di ni gsang bar bya ba nyid yin te/67—884

gzhan du na chos kyi sku la dgongs pa ma shes nas sangs rgyas gcig kho na bzhugs kyi gzhan rnams la sangs rgyas mi srid pas tshogs bsags pa don med do snyam nas log par lta ba skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nyid kyi phyir bsnyad ①pa ma lags so zhes gsungs so/ /gang gis ②chos kyi sku la brten nas 'di gsungs pa yin no zhes shes pa de la 'di bstan par bya ba yin no zhes pa'o②/ /de 'grel pas bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ sangs rgyas zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs pa la sogs pa bstan pa gang yin pa de ni sprul pa'i sku'i ④sgo nas yin gyi rdo rje'i gdan du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa mngon du mdzad pa ni ma yin nol/ /sprul pa'i sku 'byung ba'i rgyu zhes bya ba ni chos kyi sku'o//de'i bya ba ni chos kyi sku'o/ /de'i tshad ces bya ba ni dus kyi'o/ /de la ⑥zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten gyi khams na'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bsags pa rnams kyis ⑦zhes bya ba ni dus ji srid pa'i nyan thos la sogs pa'i rigs can rnams kyis so/ /de lhag par mos par byed pa rnams la zhes bya ⑧ba ni chos kyi sku la lhag par mos par byed pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rigs rnams la'o/ /bzhugs pa'i dus bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ de ltar re zhig ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/mchog tu rab zhi bar zhes bya ba ni mchog tu rnam par mi rtog pa'i gnas skabs na'o / /nam mkha' rnam 'jig 'gyur min de srid du/ /zhes bya ba ni nam mkha' ji srid du 'jig par mi 'gyur ba de srid du khyod la zhi bar 'gyur ba ⑨yin te / mya ngan las 'das pa gang la mnga' zhes sbyar bar bya'o/ /shes rab yul ⑩gyis bskyed pa zhes bya ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgoms pas chos sku mngon du mdzad pas so0/ /thugs brtse ma ma'i tshul lugs zhes bya ba ni 61—885

thugs rje'i dbang gis 'khor ba ji srid par bzhugs pa ste/ chos kyi sku'i dbang gis ①sems can gyi don bya ba rgyun mi chad ②par 'gyur bas de gnas pa yin no zhes pa'o/ /de 'grel pas bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das ni zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so/ /dri ba'i sgo nas snying rje'i rang bzhin bstan par bya ba'i phyir gang gi zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ gang gi tshe ②zhes bya ba snying rjes so/ /de'i rang bzhin ston pa ni/ bshad pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te⑦/ ji ltar khyod de sangs rgyas skye bo rnams la thugs brtse ba de ltar kha zas dug dang bcas pa'i zas kyis phyis bu 'gre zhulog byed pa mas mthong ba la ⑦sdug bsngal de yid ⑦mi bde ba 'byung bar 'gyur ba'o//skye bo'i khyad par ni nang mi ⑧zhes bya ba smos te/ ngas 'di drang bar bya'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes pas so/ /yang skye bo'i khyad par ni 'jig rten kha zas dug bcas za ba'i zhes bya ba gsungs te/ gzugs dang sgra la sogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga la 'jig rten pa'i kha zas zhes bya ba ⑨la/ de ⑩bden par zhen pa'i longs spyod pa'i phyir 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yin pas dug dang bcas pa'o/ /ci'i phyir zhe na/ gti mug skyon gyis zhes bya ba gsungs te/ma rig pa'i stobs kyis zhes bya ba'i tha tshig go/ /de nas mgon po ⑪mchog tu rab zhir gshegs par 'gyur ba lags/ /zhes bya ba ni gang gi phyir bden par mngon par zhen pa 'jig rten pa rnams sdug bsngal gyi rgyur gyur pa'i ⑫'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga la longs spyod pa de'i phyir sdug bsngal sel bar dam bcas pa khyod mya ngan las 'das par 8mi 'gyur ba'o/ /de 'grel pas bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ 'jig rten zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ 'dod 61—886

pa'i yon tan zhes bya ba la/ 'dod par bya bas na 'dod pa ste/ gzugs la sogs pa rnams so/ /de rnams nyid goms par bya ba yin pas na yon tan lnga'o//'di nyid du mngon par zhen pa zhes bya ba ni gang gzugs la sogs pa nyams su myong ba 'di ①ni bden pa yin no zhes mngon par zhen pa'o/ /sdug bsngal rgya chen po'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir zhes bya ba ni dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rgya chen po'i rgyu yin pas so/ /gti mug gi skyon las zhes bya ba ni ma rig pa'i skyon gyis de kho na nyid mi shes pas so/ /de ltar snying rje'i rang bzhin bstan nas khyad par du 'jig rten sdug bsngal bar gzigs nas thugs rje'i dbang gis bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'da' bar mi 'gyur ro zhes bstan par bya ba'i phyir thugs rjes zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ sdug bsngal sna tshogs nyams su myong ba'i gzhir gyur pa zhes bya ba la skye ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs pa yin la/ de nyams su myong ba'i rten du gyur pa'i 'jig rten na②/ /dngos po dang dngos po med par zhen pa'i blo can gyis zhes bya ba ni las dang 'bras bu la yid ches par ②yod na 'jig rten pha rol yod do zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i dngos po la mngon par zhen pa'i blo 'byung bas ⑦dngos po la mngon par zhen pa'i blo can zhes bya'o/ /log par lta ba yod na 'jig rten pha rol med do zhes bya ba la sogs pa la ⑦dngos po med pa la mngon par zhen pa'i blo can no/ /de la khyad par gyi sgo nas rgyu mtshan bstan par bya ba'i phyir mi mkhas pa zhes bya ba gsungs te/ gang gi phyir ma rig ①pa dang ldan pa de'i phyir ro/ /'jig rten gnas skabs dang zhes bya ba ni mi rtag pa'i gnas skabs te/ 'dis ni rga shi dag bstan pa yin te/ gnyis ka la mi rtag pa nyid kyis khyab pas so/ /sdug 61—887

dang mi sdug phrad bral gyisal/ /bskyed ces bya ba ni mdza' ba dang bral bas bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal dang / mi mdza' ba dang phrad pas bskyed pa'i sdug bsngal lo/ /'di ni dngos po la mngon par zhen pa'i sdug bsngal lo/ /dngos po med pa la mngon par zhen pa'i 'bras bu bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ sdig can 'gro ba thob pa zhes bya ba gsungs te/ mnar med pa la sogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams so/ /zhi las zhes bya ba ni bag chags dang bcas pa'i nyon mongs pa spangs su zin kyang ngo / /de 'grel pas bstan par bya ba'i phyir de la gang gi phyir zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ las dang 'bras bu la yid ches pa zhes bya ba ni/ yang dag pa'i lta ba yod na'o/ /yod par lta ba zhes bya ba ni las dang 'bras bu dag yod par lta ba'o/ /gong du bshad pa'i sdug bsngal zhes bya ba ni skye ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rnams so/ /da ni dbu ma la 'jug pa'i bstan bcos las kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa'i rnam gzhag mdzad pa de gzhan rnams dang / thun mong ma yin no zhes bstan par bya ba'i phyir/lugs 'di zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ lugs 'di zhes bya ba ni kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa'i ②rnam gzhag go/ /dge slong zhes bya ba ni dge slong gi sdom pa dang ldan pa'o/ /dbu ma'i bstan bcos las btus nas/ /zhes bya ba ni slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma rtsa ba'i ②shes rab la sogs pa nas btus nas ①so/ /lung ji bzhin du zhes bya ba ni mdo sde la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid can gyi lung dang mi 'gal bar ro/ /man ngag ni ji lta ba bzhin zhes bya ba ni/ gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i ⑦gdams ngag gi rjes su 'brangs nas so/ /'di las 61—888

gzhan na chos 'di ni zhes bya ba ni ji ltar dbu ma'i bstan bcos 'di las gzhan na stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid can gyi ①chos 'di ni yod pa ma yin la/ de bzhin du dbu ma la 'jug pa'i bstan bcos 'di ni kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i rnam gzhag gang byas pa de bstan bcos gzhan rnams na yod pa ma yin no zhes mkhas pa rnams kyis nges par mdzod ces pa'o/ /de 'grel pas bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ ci ltar zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ bstan bcos gzhan las zhes ②bya ba ni/ dbyig gnyen la sogs pas byas pa las so/ /bstan bcos gzhan la tshul lugs 'di yod pa ma yin no zhes gsal bar bya ba'i phyir/de'i phyir zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ kha cig gis zhes bya ba ni slob dpon 'ga' zhig gis so/ /lugs 'ga' zhig don dam par smras pa zhes bya ba la mdo sde pa'i 'dod pa ni gang snang ba de shes pa las tha mi dad pas ②yin te/dper na zla ba gnyis su snang ba la sogs pa bzhin no/ /sngon po la sogs pa yang snang ba nyid yin pas des na shes pa la ①tha mi dad pa yin no/ /sngon po la sogs par snang ba de rnams kyang res 'ga' snang ba ⑤res 'ga' mi snang bas res 'ga' ba yin pa'i phyir/ de ①rgyu khas blang dgos kyi gzhan du na rgyu med pas ⑦gzhan la mi ltos pa'i duphyir/ rtag tu yod pa 'am med par 'gyur zhes bya ba'i rigs pas rtag tu yod pa'am med par 'gyur ro/ /des na sngon po la sogs pa snang ba 'di rnams kyi rgyu gang yin pa de ni phyi rol gyi don yin pas ⑨de yang mi rtag la/ shes pa yang mi rtag pa yin la/ de gnyis ka yang dbang phyug la sogs pa'i byed pa dang bral ba dang / bdag dang bdag gi ba dang bral ba'o/ /de dag mi rtag pa la sogs par yongs su shes pas bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin 61da 889

pa la sogs pa las/ bdag dang bdag gi bas kun nas bslang ba'i 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams med pas rnam par grol ba yin no zhes bya ba 'di ni mdo sde pa rnams kyi lugs don dam par smras pa'o①/ /de nyid ces bya ba ni lugs don dam pa nyid do/ /kun rdzob tu 'dod do zhes bya ba ni don dam pa'i rnam gzhag byas pa de kun rdzob nyid du 'dod pa yin no zhes bya'o/ /de yang mi rigs so zhes bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ de ni zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ dbu ma'i bstan bcos kyi don gyi de kho na nyid mngon par mi shes pa zhes bya ba ni/ gang dbu ma'i bstan bcos kyi ②don phyin ci ma log pa de ni mi shes pa nyid kyis de ltar brjod pa yin te②/ de lta bu'i rnam pa can gyi don 'jig rten la grags pa med pa yin no zhes sngar bstan to/ /yang gzhan dag gi 'dod pa la skyon bstan par bya ba'i yang ①gang dag ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ slob dpon kha cig na re gang bye brag tu smra ba rnams kyis rnam gzhag byas pa ⑤dbu ma pa rnams kyi kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag yin no zhes 'dod pa yin no/ /ji ltar bye brag tu smra ba rnams kyis don dam par 'dus byas kyi chos dang / 'dus ma byas kyi chos kyang khas len pa yin no/ /de la 'dus ma byas ni nam mkha' dang / so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa dang / so sor brtags pa ma yin pa'i 'gog pa'o/ /de la nam mkha' ni mi sgrib pa'i mtshan nyid can no/ /so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa ni/ so sor brtags shing dpyad na nyon mongs pa rnams kyis ①'gog pa gang thob pas so/ /so sor brtags pa ma yin pa'i 'gog pa ni rgyu ma tshang bas 'gog pa thob pa gang yin pa ste/ dper na gzugs gcig la mig dang yid zhugs pa'i skyes bu la/ gzugs gzhan la rgyu ma tshang 67—890

bas mig gi rnam par shes pa'i 'gog pa thob pas/ mig gi rnam par shes pa mi skye ba lta bu'o/ /'dus byas ni gzugs dang tshor ba la sogs pa'o/ /de dag thams cad mi rtag ①pa dang / bdag dang bdag gi ba dang bral ba dang /dbang phyug la sogs pa'i byed pa po dang bral ba'o/ /de rnams mi rtag pa la sogs par yongs su shes pa las sngar bzhin du grol bar 'gyur bas so/ /de la rigs pa ma yin zhes bstan par bya ba'i phyir snyam du sems pa dag gis kyang zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ dag gis kyang zhes bya ba ni gang de ltar brjod pa de rnams kyis kyang ngo / /ma rig pa nyid bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ ji ltar zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos zhes bya ba ni / bye brag tu smra ba dang / mdo sde pas don dam par brtags pa gang yin pa'o—/ /'jig rten pa'i chos dang chos mtshungs par mi rigs ②pa'i phyir zhes bya ba ni 'jig rten pa'i chos rnams ni 'jig rten pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas grub pa yin gyi/ mi rtag pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid dang / bdag med pa nyid la sogs pa ni 'jig rten pa nyid las grub pa ma yin no/ /des ni 'jig rten las 'das pa dang 'jig rten pa dag chos mtshungs par mi 'gyur ba'o/ /lugs 'di ni thun mong ②ma yin pa'o zhes bya ba ni kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i rnam gzhag 'di thun mong ma yin pa ste/ gzhan la ①yod pa ma yin no zhes pa'o//de ltar yang 'jig rten pa'i rjes su 'brangs ①nas kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag byas pa shugs kyis gzhan gyis kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag byas pa ①de rigs pa ma yin par grub pas thun mong ma yin pa'o/ /de nyid kyi phyir zhes bya ba ni lugs 'di gzhan gyis mi shes shing zhes kho bos khong du chud pas so/ /thugs dgongs mi 61—891

shes shing zhes bya ba ni kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i rnam gzhag go/ /don gyi de kho na nyid nges par zin pa med pa zhes bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa rnams chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin can gyi don du nges par ma zin par ro/ /yi ge tsam nges par 'jigs ①par 'gyur ba rnams kyis zhes bya ba ni sangs rgyas yongs su brtag pa dang / bden pa bzhi yongs su brtag pa dag las sangs rgyas bkag pa dang / bden pa bzhi bkag pa'i tshul gyis don nges par byas te 'jig par 'gyur ba rnams kyis so/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos 'di zhes bya ba ni/ sgrib pa gnyis spong ba'i rgyur gyur pa'i de kho na nyid bstan pa'o②//bstan bcos kyi don gyi de kho na nyid phyin ci ma log par bstan par bya ba'i phyir zhes bya ba ni bstan bcos las gsungs pa de phyin ci ma log pa yin gyi phyin ci log ni ma yin no zhes bstan pa'i ched du'o/ /de nyid kyi ②bstan par bya ba'i phyir / klu sgrub ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ de la klu dang srid sgrub dag dang mtshungs pa'i phyir klu sgrub ste/ ji ltar klu rnams mtsho'i ④mtha' dor nas dkyil bu gnas pa de bzhin du ⑤'dir yang yod pa dang med pa la gnas ⑥pa'i mtha' spangs nas/ dbu ma'i lam la gnas pa dang / ji ltar srid sgrub kyis mda'i tshogs kyis gzhan gyi dpung tshogs bcom pa de bzhin du 'dir yang gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi mda'i tshogs kyis srid ⑦pa'i dgra bcom pas srid sgrub dang klu dag mtshungs pa'o/ /blo mtsho zhes bya ba ni blo nyid mtsho ⑧yin te/zab pa'i phyir ro/ /shin tu rgya che zhes bya ba ni mtha' rtogs par dka' bas so//kha dog gis 'jigs pas zhes bya ba ni mtsho'i dbang du byas na sngo ba la sogs pa'i kha dog gi sgo nas sol/ /blo'i dbang du byas na blos kun nas bslangs pa'i ⑩61—892

sgra rnams kyi don ji lta ba bzhin du khong du ma chud pas 'jigs pas so/ /lugs bzang zhes bya ba ni klu sgrub zhabs kyis bzhed pa dam ①pa'o/ /rgyang rings ②spangs pa zhes bya ba ni bstan bcos kyi don ma dpyad pa ste/ bstan bcos la ma zhugs pas so zhes pa'o/ /ji ltar thag ring po nas mtsho'i kha dog shin tu 'jigs par byed pa mthong nas yongs su 'dor ba de bzhin du slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyi bstan bcos kyi sgra thos pa tsam gyis gzhan gyis yongs su spong ba ⑧yin no zhes pa'o/ /de'i tshig le'ur byas pa'i kham 'bus ku mu ta kha phye ba'i ①chus zhes bya ba ni klu sgrub zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i tshig le'ur byas pa nyid kham 'bus pa'i ku mu ta ⑤yin te/ gzhan rnams kyis de'i don gsal bar ma byas pas so/ /de'i kha bye ⑦ba ni tshig le'ur byas pa'i don gsal bar byas pas so / /de nyid chu ste de'i sgo nas so/ /da lta zla ba ⑦grags pa phyogs rnams rab tu 'gengs par byed/ /ces bya ba ⑧ni slob dpon zla ba grags pas phyogs thams cad gang bar mdzad pa'o/ /'di'i don ni ji ltar 'ga' zhig gis mtsho'i kha dog gis 'jigs pas mtsho dor la phyis 'ga' zhig 'ongs nas ⑨mtsho de nyid kyi gting du 'dzul ba dang steng du byung ba dag byas nas de las bcus pa'i chus yul yongs su gang bar byas pa de bzhin du slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyi bstan bcos kyi sgra'i 'jigs pas gzhan gyis dor ba de kho bos tshig le'ur byas pa'i don gsal bar byas pa'i chus phyogs rnams yongs su gang bar byas pa yin no zhes pa'o/ /tshig le'ur byas pa'i don khong du chud pa de thun mong ma yin no zhes bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ gal te zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ de skad du smra'o zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni de rnams kyis kyang yongs su spangs pa yin 67—893

no zhes pa'o/ /spangs par khong du chud pa'i rgyu mtshan bstan par bya ba'i phyir/bshad par bya ste zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ de nyid ces bya ba ni stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid can no/ /zab mo zhes bya ba ni don rtogs dka' bas so//'jigs rung zhes bya ba ni sgra tsam thos ①pas so/ /sngon goms pa nyid las zhes bya ba ni skye ba snga ma la de kho na nyid la thos pa dang bsam pa la sogs pa byas pas so—/ /nges par rtogs 'gyur 'di ni zhes bya ba ni the tshom med par khong du chud pa'o⑤ / /gsan rgya che yang zhes bya ba ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten nas thos pa'i mtshan nyid can rgya che yang ngo / /gzhan gyis zhes pa ni sngon goms par ma byas pa rnams kyis so/ /thugs su chud mi 'gyur zhes bya ba ni de kho na nyid rtogs par mi 'gyur ba'o/ /de'i phyir tshul lugs zhes bya ba ni kun brtags pa dang / gzhan dbang dang / yongs su grub pa'i mtshan nyid can no / /rang blos sbyar ba zhes bya ba ni slob dpon dbyig gnyen la sogs pas ③ rang rang gi blos btags ①pa'o/ /de dag mthong nas zhes bya ba ni gzhan gyi tshul lugs mthong nas so/ /bdag tu brjod gzhung lugs rnams ltar/ /zhes bya ba ni mu stegs pa rnams kyi bdag la sogs pa gsal ⑤bar byed pa'i bstan bcos rnams bzhin du'o/ /gzhan lugs zhes bya ba ni slob dpon dbyig gnyen la sogs pa'i 'dod pa'o/ /bzhed ⑦gzhung 'di las zhes bya ba ni slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyis bzhed pa las so/ /gzhan la zhes bya ba ni slob dpon dbyig gnyen la sogs pas mdzad pa las so/ /dga' blo dor ba ⑦zhes bya ba ni de rnams la blo brtan par mi bya'o zhes pa'o/ /'dir ⑧ni slob dpon klu sgrub kyi bzhed pa spangs pa yin te⑨/ sngon de kho na nyid ma goms par rgyu mtshan du 61—894

bstan pa ①yin no/ /de 'grel pas bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ ji ltar zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ 'dod pa dang / gzugs dang gzugs med pa'i nyon mongs pa spangs shing zhes bya ba ni srid pa'i rtse mo'i nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por gyur pa gong mas bsdus pa'i 'jig rten pa'i lam med pa'o②/ /de rnams kyi ②srid pa'i rtse mo'i nyon mongs pa ma ①spangs kyang zhing chag mo gang ma brdas ⑦pas brdas pa ⑦yin no zhes bya ba'i tshul gyis nyon mongs pa spangs shing zhes brjod par 'os pa yin no/ /grub pa'i mtha' gzhan nye bar sbyor nus par mthong du zin kyang zhes bya ba ni grangs can la sogs pa'i grub mtha' gzhan ⑦sbyor nus kyang ngo / /de bzhin du de dag gis kyang zhes bya ba ni slob dpon dbyig gnyen la sogs pas kyang ngo / /mang du gsan pa rnam pa de lta bu mdor ⑧zin kyang zhes bya ba ni sgra dang / tshad ma dang mngon pa la sogs pa du ma gsan du zin kyang ngo / /deng sang nyid na yang zhes bya ba ni da ltar yang ngo / /rgyu'i stobs kho na las zhes bya ba ni stong pa nyid la lhag par mos pa'i bag chags kyis so / /'di bden par mthong ba rnam par nyams pa rnams kyis kyang zhes bya ba ni slob dpon dbyig gnyen la sogs pas kyang ngo / /mang du gsan na rnam pa de lta bu mu stegs pa'i gzhung lugs 'di bden pa yin no zhes mthong ba spangs pa gang ⑨la yod pa de la de skad ces bya ste stong pa nyid la lhag par mos pa'o/ /stong pa nyid kyi gting dpog par mthong zhes bya ba ni stong pa nyid yang dag par khong du chud pa yin no zhes pa'o/ /gzhan pa'i gzhung lugs zhes bya ba ni slob dpon dbyig gnyen la sogs pas mdzad pa'o/ /bdag gsal ⑩bar byed pa'i gzhung lugs zhes bya ba ni mu stegs pa'i bstan bcos las bya ba ltar ro/ /67—895

dga' ba'i blo gros dor bar bya ste zhes bya ba ni 'di kho na nyid yin no snyam du nges par ma byed ces pa'o/ /stong pa nyid kyi lta ba la lhag par mos pa kho na la ya mtshan par rtogs par bya'o zhes bya ba ni stong pa nyid la lhag par mos pa kho na la sems brtan por gyis shig ces pa'o/ /bsod nams yongs su bsngo bar bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ slob dpon zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs te/ lugs bzang bsnyad la zhes bya ba ni kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i mtshan nyid kyi bzhed pa bstan pa las bdag gis ①bsod nams gang thob pa de ②'jig rten bde bar gshegs pa'i sa kun du 'od ces bya bar bgrod par shog ces bya bar sbyar ro/ /phyogs kyi mthar khyab cing zhes bya ba ni bsod nams de phyogs thams cad la khyab pa ste mtha' yas pa yin no zhes pa'o/ /yid mkha' zhes bya ba ni yid kho na nam mkha' yin pas na yid mkha' ste/ stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin can yin pas so//yid kyi mkha' ji lta bu zhe na/ nyon mongs kyis sngo zhes bya ba gsungs te/ glo bur ba'i nyon mongs pas dri ma can du byas pas so/ /bsod nams ji lta bu zhe na / ston dzi'i rgyu skar ltar dkar ba zhes bya ba smos te/ ston ku'i sprin dang bral bas skar ma rnams ji ltar dkar ba de bzhin du bsod nams 'di yang mi dge ba'i dri ma dang bral bas dkar ba'o/ /bsam pa'i mtshan la nyin gyi nor bu dang 'dra zhes bya ba la/ bsam pa ni yod pa dang / med par rnam par rtog pa gang yin pa'o/ /de nyid mtshan mo ste/ dngos po'i de kho na nyid yongs su mi shes pas so/ /de spang ba'i don du nyin gyi nor bu dang 'dra ba ste/ nyi ma lta bu'o/ /bsod nams 'dir ②rnam par rtog pa dang bral bas so/ /de ltar yang / skye ba 'di nyid la de nyid/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so/ /61—896

zab pa zhes bya ba ni stong pa nyid ston pas so/ /rgya che ba zhes bya ba ni sbyin pa la sogs pa lnga ston pas so/ /theg pa mchog la thugs gzhol ba/ /zhes bya ba ni theg pa chen po la thugs shin tu dang ba mnga' ba'o①/ /mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab dang thugs rje mnga' ba zhes bya ba ni shes rab dang thugs rje dag mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis zil gyis gnon par mi nus pa'o/ /ri mor bris pa'i ba drus las 'o ma bzhos pas bden par zhen pa bzlog par mdzad pas zhes bya ba ni ri mor bris pa'i ba las 'o ma bzhos pas gzhan gyi dngos por mngon par zhen pa zlog par mdzad pa des mdzad pa'o/ /dbu ma la 'jug pa'i 'grel bshad sangs rgyas kyi gnas skabs kyi 'grel pa'i bshad pa'o// //mnga' ris yul 'khrungs skye bo yon tan ldan pas kun la rab grags thugs rjer ldan/ /nor gyi tshogs kyis phongs pa mtha' dag khyab mdzad tshul khrims ma nyams mod mi dma'/ /nam yang gang gi thugs la skad cig tsam yang khro ba skyes par ma gyur pa/ /brtson 'grus kyis ni mtha' yas skyon yang ②yon tan tshogs dag 'joms shing 'phel mdzad la/ /rnam par g.yeng ba du mas gang gis ②sems ni ting nge 'dzin las mi 'phrogs shing / /shes rab phun tshogs chu yis dri ma mtha' dag 'khru ba'i nus mnga' ba/ /thabs kyis srid pa'i chu bor bying ba'i sems can mtha' yas chos kyi phyag gis 'dren mdzad cing / /skye ba du mar sbyangs pas gang gi smon lam shin tu mtha' ru son gyur pa/ /sbyin la sogs pa'i sbyor la goms pas gang gi stobs rnams kyang ni 'phel 'gyur la/ /thugs kyi bstan bcos du ma rnam spyod ⑦mkhas shing chos kyi phung po ston mdzad pa//tshul khrims dang ldan ting 'dzin bzlas brjod mngon brtson skye bo'i tshogs kyis 67—897

rgyun du bskor/ /mi nyag yul gyi mnga' bdag chos rjes bla mar bkur zhing spyi bos phyag mdzad pa/ /'gro ba rnams kyi don du sangs rgyas 'bum gyis brgyan pa'i gtsug lag khang chen mdzad/ /gang gis de las gzhan pa'i gnas rnams su yang rgya chen gtsug lag khang mdzad la/ /thugs rje phul du byung bas sems can sdug bsngal dra bas sdug bsngal gang gyur pa/ /'gro bas mthong ngam thos pas rangs pa skyed ①mdzad dge slong gsung bcad yongs kyi bshes/ /de yis gsol ba btab nas kha che yi/ /yul nas 'ongs pa'i mkhas la ②rgyal ba kun/ /dga' zhes bya bar grags pas dbu ma la/ /'jug pa 'di 'grel bshad pa'i don gsal byas/ /bdag gis 'grel bshad 'di byas las/ /bsod nams kun da zla 'dra la/ /gang thob de yis 'jig rten kun/ /dbu ma'i gnas thob rgyal gyur cig /dbu ma la 'jug pa'i 'grel pa'i bshad pa/ don gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dza ya ā nan das mdzad pa rdzogs so// //longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa lha yi yul dang mtshungs/ /chos rgyal gdung mi 'chad par 'byung ba'i mi nyag yul/ /chu bo rma yi ngogs dang ri bo rtse lnga'i 'dabs/ /rgyal po'i pho brang dpung gi tshogs bcas ②gnas pa yi/ /khyad par mkhar sku zhes bya'i gtsug lag khang chen du/ /kha che'i mkhas pa chen po rtsom mdzad de nyid dang / /bod kyi lo tsā ⑦ban+de kun dga' grags zhes pas/ /dbu ma la 'jug 'grel bshad don gsal zhes bya bsgyur/ /'di bsgyur ba las dge ba gang / /thob des 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /sgrib pa rnam gnyis yongs ⑤spangs nas/ /bla med byang chub thob par shog /kha che'i mkhas pa chen po dza 67—898

pa la/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na/ /phyis 'di yang dag 'byor par ga la 'gyur/ /ji ltar mtshan mo mun nag sprin rum na/ /glog 'gyu skad cig bar 1snang ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas mthu yis brgya lam na/ /'jig rten bsod nams blo gros thang 'ga' 'byung / /de ltas dge ba nyam chung nyid la rtagan /sdig pa stobs chen shin tu mi bzad pa/ /de ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems min pa/ /dge gzhan gang gis zil gyis gnon par 'gyur/ /bskal pa du mar rab dgongs mdzad pa yi/ /thub dbang rnams kyis 'di nyid phan par gzigs/ /'dis ni tshad med skye bo'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /bde mchog bde blag nyid du thob par byed/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal brgya phrag gzhom 'dod cing / /sems can mi bde bsal bar 'dod pa dang / /bde mang brgya phrag spyod ngapar 'dod pas kyang / /byang chub sems nyid rtag tu gtang mi bya/ /byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta buzhi/ /mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku/ /rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas na/ /byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brtan zung / /'gro ba'i ded dpon gcig pu tshad med blos/ /legs par yongs su brtags na rin che bas/ /'gro ba'i gnas dang bral bar 'dod pa rnams / /rin chen byang chub sems legs brtan par zung / /dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni/ /'bras bu bskyed nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid//byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang / /'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 61—952

'phel bar 'gyur/ /sdig pa shin tu mi bzad byas na yang / /dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa chen po ltar/ /gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol 'gyur ba / /de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi brten/ /des ni dus mtha'i me bzhin sdig chen rnams/ /skad cig gcig gis nges par sreg 1par byed/ /de yi phan yon dpag tu med pa dag /byams mgon blo dang ldan pas nor bzangs 2bshad/ /byang chub sems de mdor bsdus 2na/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste/ /byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni/ /byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no/ /'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar/ /de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyirī+o/ /bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya/ /byang chub smon pa'i sems las ni/ /'khor tshe 'bras bu che 'byung yang / /ji ltar 'jug pa'i sems bzhin du/ /bsod nams rgyun chags 'byung ba min/ /gang nas bzung ste sems can khams/ /mtha' yas rab tu dgrol duba'i phyir/ /mi ldog pa yi sems kyis su/ /sems de yang dag blangs gyur pa/ / deng nas bzung gyeste gnyid log gam/ /bag med gyur kyang bsod nams shugs/ /rgyun mi 'chad par du ma zhig /nam mkha' mnyam par rab tu 'byung / /'di ni 'thad pa dang bcas par/ /lag bzang gis 7ni zhus pa las/ /dman mos sems can don gyi phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis gsungs/ /sems can rnams kyi klad nad tsam/ /bsal lo snyam du bsams na yang / /phan 'dogs bsam pa dang ldan deḥ/ /bsod nams dpag med ldan gyur na/ /sems can re re'i mi bde ba/ /dpag tu med pa bsal 'dod cing / /re re'ang yon tan dpag med du/ /bsgrub par 'dod pa smos ci dgos/ /61—953

pa'am yang na ma yang rung / /su la 'di 'dra'i phan sems yod/ /lha dang drang srong rnams kyang rung / /tshangs pa la yang 'di yod dam/ /sems can de dag nyid la sngon/ /rang gi don du 7'di 'dra'i sems/ /rmi lam du yang ma rmis na/ /gzhan gyi don du ga la skye/ /gzhan dag rang gi don du yang / /mi 'byung sems can don sems gang / /sems kyi rin chen khyad par 'di/ /snga ⑤na med pa'i rmad cig 'khrungs/ /'gro ba kun gyi dga' ba'i rgyu/ /sems can sdug bsngal rtsir gyur pa/ /rin chen sems kyi bsod nams gang / /de la ji ltar gzhal ④gyis lang / /phan par bsams pa tsam gyis kyang / /sangs rgyas mchod las khyad 'phags na/ /sems can ma lus thams cad kyi/ /bde don brtson pa smos ci dgos/ /sdug bsngal 'dor 'dod sems yod kyang / /sdug bsngal nyid la mngon par rgyug④ /bde ba 'dod kyang gti mug pas/ /rang gi bde ba dgra ltar 'joms/ /gang zhig bde bas phongs pa dang / /sdug bsngal mang ldan de dag la/ /bde ba kun gyis tshim pa dang / /sdug bsngal thams cad gcod byed cing / /gti mug kyang ni sel byed pa⑤/ /de dang dge mtshungs ga la yod/ /de 'dra'i bshes kyang ga la yod/ /bsod nams de 'dra'ang ga la yod/ /phan btags lan lon ⑥gang yin pa/ /de yang re zhig bsngags 'os na/ /ma bcol legs par byed pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' smos ci dgos/ /'gro ba nyung zad nar ma'i zas sbyor ba/ /skad cig zas tsam sbyin par byed pa dang / /brnyas bcas nyin phyed 'drangs ④par byed pa yang / /dge ba byed pa yin zhes skye bos bkur/ /sems can grangs phyomatha' yas la dus ring du/ /bde bar gshegs kyi bde ba bla na med/ /yid 67da 954

la bsam pa mtha' dag rdzogs byed pa/ /rtag tu sbyin pa lta zhig smos ci dgos/ /gang zhig de 'dra'i rgyal sras sbyin bdag la/ /gal te ngan sems skyed par byed na de/ /ngan sems bskyed pa'i grangs bzhin bskal par ni/ /dmyal bar gnas par 'gyur zhes thub pas gsungs/ /'on te gang zhig yid rab dang byed na/ /de yi 'bras bu de bas lhag par 'phel/ /rgyal sras rnams la do gal chen pos kyang / /sdig pa mi 'byung dge ba ngang gis 'phel/ /gang la sems kyi dam pa rin chen de/ /skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing / /gang la gnod pa byas kyang bde 'brel ba/ /bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi / /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ byang chub 1sems kyi phan yon bshad pa zhes bya ba 3ste le'u dang po'o// //rin chen sems de gzung nabar bya ba'i phyir/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos/ /dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras/ /yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la legs par mchod/ /me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang / /sman gyi rnam pa gang zhig ngayod pa dang / /'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang / /chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba ci yod dang / /rin chen ri bo dang ni de bzhin du/ /nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' dang / /ljon shing me tog rgyan spras spud pa dang / /shing gang 'bras bzang yal ga dud pa dang / /lha sogs 'jig rten na yang dri dang ni/ /spos dang dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing / /ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog rnam pa dang / /gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams ni/ /mtsho dang rdzing bu pad+mas 61—955

brgyan pa dag /ngang pa shin tu skad snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /nam mkha' rab 'byams 2khams kyi mthas gtugs nan/ /yongs su gzung ba med pa de dag kun / /blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog /sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na/ /yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis / /bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes/ /bdag ni bsod nams mi ldan bkren chen te/ /mchod pa'i nor gzhan bdag la cang ma mchis/ /des na gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon gyis 'di/ /bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig /rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni/ /bdag gi lus kun gtan du dbul bar bgyi/ /sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi/ /bdag ni khyed kyis yongs su bzung bas na/ /srid na mi 'jigs sems can phan pa bgyid5 / /sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' bgyid cing / /sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do/ /khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa/ /shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba ltar6/ /rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig 'od chags bla re 7bris pa der/ /de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu/ /yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o/ /de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul8/ /gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang / /rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis/ /'phags pa kun du bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang / /'jig 61—956

rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi/ /stong gsum kun du dri ngad ldang ba yi/ /dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang kun gyi sku/ /gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar/ /'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi/ /thub dbang mchod gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i/ /me tog man+da ra dang pad+ma dang / /ut+pal la sogs dri zhim thams cad dang / /phreng ba spel legs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod/ /spos mchog yid 'phrog dri ngad khyab pa yi/ /bdug pa'i sprin tshogs rnams kyang de la dbul/ /zhal zas bza' btung sna tshogs bcas pa yi//lha bshos rnams kyang de la dbul bar bgyi/ /gser gyi pad+ma tshar du dngar ba yi//rin chen sgron ma ①rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi/ /sa gzhi bstar ba spos kyis byugs pa der/ /me tog yid 'ong sil ma dgram par bya⑤/ /gzhal med pho brang bstod dbyangs yid 'ong ldan/ /mu tig rin chen rgyan 'phyang mdzes 'bar ba—/ /dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kyang / /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can la dbul bar bgyi/ /rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can//khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan/ /dbyibs legs blta ⑧na sdug pa bsgreng ba yang / /rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /sems can sdug bsngal tshim byed pa'i/ /sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang / /mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la//rin chen me tog la sogs char/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas/ /rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs/ /mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod//67—957

yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod/ /bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la/ /nges par kun du 'byung gyur cig /dus gsum gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kun/ /chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la//zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi/ /lus btud pa yis ①bdag phyag 'tshal/ /byang chub sems kyi gzhi rnams dang / /mchod rten rnams la ②bdag phyag 'tshal//mkhan po de bzhin slob dpon dang / /brtul zhugs mchog la phyag 'tshal lo /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi②/ /chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ /phyogs rnams kun na bzhugs pa yi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems/ /thugs rje chen po mnga' rnams la/ /thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni/ /thog ma med ldan 'khor ba nas/ /tshe rabs 'di 'am gzhan dag tu/ /bdag gis ma 'tshal sdig bgyis pa'am/ /bgyid du stsal ba nyid dang ni/ /gti mug 'khrul pas bdag non te/ /rjes su yid rangs ⑦gang bgyis pa/ /nongs pa de ni mthong bgyis nas/ /bsam pa thag pas mgon la bshags/ /bdag gis dkon mchog gsum dang ni/ /pha ma'am bla ma gzhan dag la/ /nyon mongs sgo nas lus ngag dang / /yid kyis gnod bgyis gang lags dang / /nyes pa du mas ⑤skyon chags pa'i/ /sdig can bdag gis sdig pa gang / /shin tu mi bzad bgyis pa de/ /thams cad 'dren pa rnams la bshags⑦/ /bdag ni sdig pa ma byang bar/ /sngon du 'gum par 'gyur du mchi/ /ji ltar 'di las nges thar bar/ /myur ba'i tshul gyis bskyab tu gsol/ /yid brtan mi rung 'chi bdag 'di/ /byas dang ma byas mi sdod pas/ /na dang mi na kun gyis 67—958

kyang / /glo bur tshe la yid mi brtan/ /thams cad bor te chas dgos par①/ /bdag gis de ltar ma shes nas②/ /mdza' dang mi mdza'i ②don gyi phyir/ /sdig pa rnam pa sna tshogs byas/ /mi mdza' rnams kyang med 'gyur zhing / /mdza' ba rnams kyang med par 'gyur/ /bdag kyang med par 'gyur ba ste/ /de bzhin thams cad med par 'gyur/ /rmi lam nyams su myong ba bzhin/ /dngos po gang dang gang spyad pa/ /de de dran pa'i yul du 'gyur/ /'das pa thams cad mthong mi 'gyur/ /re zhig gson tshe 'di nyid la/ /mdza' dang mi mdza' du ma 'das/ /de dag don du byas pa'i sdig /mi bzad gang yin mdun na gnas/ /de ltar bdag ni glo ⑦bur zhes/ /bdag gis rtogs par ma gyur pas/ /gti mug chags dang zhe sdang gis/ /sdig pa rnam pa du ma byas//nyin mtshan sdod pa yod med par/ /tshe 'di rtag tu god 'gyur zhing / /snon pa gud nas 'ong med na/ /bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur/ /bdag ni mal na 'dug bzhin du/ /gnyen bshes kun gyis mtha' bskor kyang ⑦/ /srog 'chad pa yi tshor ba dag /bdag nyid gcig pus myong bar 'gyur/ /gshin rje'i pho nyas zin pa la/ /gnyen gyis ci phan bshes ci phan/ /de tshe bsod nams gcig bskyabs ①na/ /de yang bdag gis ma bsten to/ /mgon po bag med bdag gis ni/ /'jigs pa 'di 'dra ma 'tshal nas/ /mi rtag tshe 'di'i ched dag tu/ /sdig pa mang po nye bar bsgrubs/ /skye bo yan lag bcad pa'i sar/ /di ring khrid pa'ang bred 'gyur te/ /kha skams mig rtsa ngan la sogs/ /snga las gzhan du 'gyur snang na/ /gshin rje'i pho nya 'jigs 'jigs lta'i/ /sha tshugs can gyis bzung gyur cing / /'jigs chen nad 61—959

kyis thebs gyur pa/ /rab tu nyam thag smos ci dgos/ /su zhig 'jigs chen 'di las bdag /legs par skyob par byed 'gyur zhes/ /bred sha thon pa'i mig bgrad nas/ /phyogs bzhir skyabs dag tshol bar byed/ /phyogs bzhir skyabs med mthong nas ni/ /de nas kun du yi mug 'gyur/ /gnas der skyabs yod ma yin na/ /de tshe bdag gis ji ltar bya/ /de bas rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa/ /stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel la/ /di ring nyid ①nas skyabs su mchi/ /de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos /'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel ba dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang / /de bzhin yang dag skyabs su mchi/ /bdag ni 'jigs pas rnam skrag pas②/ /kun du bzang la bdag nyid 'bul/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la ②bdag nyid kyis//bdag gi lus ni dbul bar bgyi/ /thugs rjes spyod pa ma 'khrul ba/ /spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang / /nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod/ /sdig ldan bdag la bskyab ①tu gsol/ /'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang / /sa yi snying po dag dang ni/ /thugs rje che mgon thams cad la/ /skyabs tshol snying nas 'o dod 'bod/ /gang zhig mthong nas ⑦gshin rje yi/ /pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams/ /skrag nas phyogs bzhir 'byer byed ①pa/ /rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi/ /sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das/ /da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas/ /khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyis/ /'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol/ /tha mal nad kyis 'jigs na yang / /sman pa'i ngag bzhin bya dgos na/ /'dod chags la sogs nyes pa brgya'i/ /nad kyis rtag btab smos ci dgos/ /de gcig gis kyang 'dzam gling na/ /gnas pa'i mi kun 67—960

brlag ①byed la/ /de dag gso ba'i sman gzhan ni/ /phyogs rnams kun nas mi rnyed na/ /de la sman pa thams cad mkhyen/ /zug rngu thams cad 'byin pa yi / /bka' ltar mi byed sems pa ni/ /shin tu gti mug smad pa'i gnas/ /②g.yang sa tha mal chung ngu la'ang / /bag yod gnas par bya dgos na/ /dpag tshad stong du lhung ba yi/ /yun ring g.yang sar smos ci dgos/ /di ring kho na mi 'chi zhes/ /bde bar 'dug pa rigs ma yin/ /bdag ni med par 'gyur ba'i dus/ /de ni gdon mi za bar 'byung / /bdag la mi 'jigs su yis ②byin/ /'di las ji ltar nges thar zhes/ /gdon mi za bar med 'gyur na/ / ji ltar ①bdag yid bde bar 'dug /sngon chad myong ste zhig pa las/ /bdag la lhag pa ci yod na/ /bdag ni de la mngon ④zhen nas/ /bla ma'i bka' dang 'gal bar byas/ /gson tshe 'di dang de bzhin du/ /gnyen dang bshes pa rnam spangs nas/ /gcig pu ga shed 'gro dgos na/ /mdza' dang mi mdza' kun ci rung / /mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung / /de las ji ltar nges thar zhes/ /nyin mtshan rtag tu bdag gis ni/ /'di nyid 'ba' zhig bsam pa'i rigs/ /bdag ni mi shes gti mug pas/ /rang bzhin kha na ma tho'am⑦/ /bcas pa'i sdig pa gang yin las/ /gang yang rung ba bgyis pa rnams/ /mgon po'i spyan sngar mngon sum du/ /thal sbyar sdug bsngal 'jigs sems kyis/ /yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te/ /de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi/ /'dren pa rnams kyis bdag gi sdig /nongs pa lags par gzung du gsol/ /'di ni bzang po ma lags pas/ /slan chad bdag ni yong mi bgyid/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/67—961

sdig pa bshags pa'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// //sems can kun gyi ngan song gi/ /sdug bsngal ngal so'i dge ba dang / /sdug bsngal can dag bder gnas la/ /dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo / /byang chub rgyur gyur dge bsags pa/ /de la rjes su yi rang ngo / /lus can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las/ /nges par thar la yi rang ngo / /skyob pa rnams kyi byang chub dang / /rgyal sras sa la'ang yi rang ngo / /sems can thams cad bde mdzad pa'i/ /thugs bskyed dge ba rgya mtsho dang / /sems can phan pa ①mdzad pa la/ /dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo / /phyogs rnams kun gyi sangs rgyas la/ /thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni/ /sems can sdug bsngal mun 'joms la / /chos kyi sgron ma ②sngar du gsol/ /rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed la/ /thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni/ /'gro 'di ldongs par mi dgod cing / /bskal pa grangs med bzhugs par gsol/ /de ltar 'di dag kun byas te/ /dge ba bdag gis bsags pa gang / /des ni sems can thams cad kyi/ /sdug bsngal thams cad bsal bar shog /'gro ba nad pa ji srid du/ /nad sos gyur gyi bar du ni/ /sman dang sman pa nyid dag dang / /de yi nad g.yog byed par shog /zas dang skom gyi char phab ste/ /bkres dang skom pa'i sdug bsngal ༅bsal / /mu ge'i bskal pa bar ma'i tshe/ /bdag ni zas dang skom du gyur/ /sems can phongs shing dbul ba la/ /bdag ni mi zad gter gyur te/ /yo byad mkho dgu sna tshogs su/ /mdun du nye bar gnas gyur cig /lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge ba thams cad kyang / /sems can 61—962

kun gyi don sgrub phyir/ /phongs pa med par gtang bar bya/ /thams cad btang bas mya ngan 'da'/ /bdag blo mya ngan 'das pa sgrub①/ /thams cad gtong bar chabs gcig la/ /sems can rnams la btang ba ②mchog /bdag gis lus can thams cad la/ /lus 'di ci bder byin zin gyis/ /rtag tu gsod dang smod pa'am/ /brdeg sogs ci dgar byed la rag /bdag gi lus la rtse byed dam/ /co 'dri ga zha'i rgyu byed kyang / /bdag gi thu lus 'di byin zin gyis/ /'di yi kha tas ci zhig bya/ /de la gnod par mi 'gyur ba'i/ /las gang yin pa'ang ①byed du chug /bdag la dmigs nas nam du yang / /'ga' yang don med ma gyur cig /bdag la dmigs nas gang dag gi/ /khro 'am ①dad pa'i sems byung ba①/ /de nyid rtag tu de dag gi/ /don kun 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /gang dag bdag la kha zer ram/ /gzhan dag ⑦gnod pa byed pa'am/ /de bzhin phyar ka gtong yang rung / /thams cad byang chub skal ldan gyur/ /bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi ⑤mgon/ /lam zhugs rnams kyi ded dpon dang / /brgal ⑨'dod rnams kyi gru dang ni/ /gzings dang zam pa nyid du gyur/ /gling don gnyer la gling dang ni/ /gnas mal 'dod la gnas mal dang / /bdag ni lus can bran 'dod pa/ /kun gyi bran du gyur par 0shog /yid bzhin nor dang ⑪bum pa bzang rig sngags grub dang sman chen dang / /dpag bsam gyi ni shing dag dang / /lus can rnams kyi 'dod 'jor gyur/ /sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang / /nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang / /sems can dpag tu med pa yi/ /rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir ⑫yang shog /de bzhin nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i/ /67—963

sems can khams la rnam kun du/ /thams cad mya ngan 'das bar du/ /bdag ni nyer ①'tsho'i rgyur yang shog /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la/ /de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing / /de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi/ /de ltar blo dang ldan pa yis/ /rab dang byang chub sems bzung nas/ /mjug kyang rgyas par bya ba'i phyir②/ /sems ni 'di ltar gzengs ②bstod do/ /deng du bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /di ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su bdag deng gyur/ /da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang / /rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya/ /long bas phyag dar phung po las/ /ji ltar rin chen rnyed pa ltar//de bzhin ji zhig ltar stes nas/ /byang chub sems 'di bdag la skyes/ /'gro ba'i 'chi bdag 'joms byed pa'i/ /bdud rtsi ①mchog kyang 'di yin no/ /'gro ba'i dbul ba sel ba yi/ /mi zad gter yang 'di yin no/ /'gro ba'i nad rab zhi byed pa'i/ /sman gyi mchog kyang 'di yin no/ /srid lam 'khyam ⑤zhing dub pa yi/ /'gro ba'i ngal so ljon shing yin/ /'gro ba thams cad ngan 'gro las/ /sgrol bar byed pa'i spyi stegs yin/ /'gro ba'i nyon mongs gdung sel ba'i/ /sems kyi zla ba shar ba yin/ /'gro ba'i mi shes rab rib dag /dpyis 'byin nyi ma chen po yin/ /dam chos 'o ma bsrubs pa las⑦ mar gyi nying khu byung ba yin/ /'gro ba'i mgron po lasrid pa'i lam rgyu zhing / /bde 67da 964

ba'i longs spyod spyad par 'dod pa la/ /'di ni bde ba'i mchog tu nyer gnas te / /sems can mgron ①chen tshim par byed pa yin/ /bdag gis di ring skyob pa thams cad kyi/ /spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni/ /bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis/ /lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ byang chub kyi sems yongs su gzung ②ba zhes bya ba ste le'u gsum pa'o// //rgyal ba'i sras kyis de lta bur/ /byang chub sems rab brtan bzung nas//g.yel ba med par rtag tu yang / /bslab las mi 'da' 'bad par bya/ /bab col brtsams pa gang yin pa'am/ /gang zhig legs par ma brtags pa/ /de ni dam bcas byas gyur kyang / /bya'am btang zhes brtags ②pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang de yi sras/ /shes rab chen pos gang brtags shing / /bdag nyid kyis kyang brtag brtags pa/ /de la bshol du ci zhig yod/ /gal te de ltar dam bcas nas/ /las kyis bsgrub pa ⑦ma byas na/ /sems can de dag kun bslus pas/ /bdag gi 'gro ba ci 'drar 'gyur/ /dngos po phal pa cung zad la'ang / /yid kyis sbyin par bsam ⑤byas nas/ /mi gang sbyin par mi byed pa/ /de yang yi dwags 'gyur gsungs na/ /bla na med pa'i bde ba la//bsam pa thag pas mgron gnyer nas/ /'gro ba thams cad bslu byas na⑥/ /bde 'gror ji ga 'gro 'gyur ram/ /mi gang byang chub sems btang yang / /de dag thar bar byed ⑦pa ni/ /las tshul bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ /thams cad mkhyen pa kho nas mkhyen/ /de ni byang chub sems dpa' la/ /ltung ba'i nang 67—965

na lci ba ste/ /'di ltar de ni byung gyur na/ /sems can kun gyi don la dman/ /gang gzhan skad cig tsam yang 'di'i①/ /bsod nams bar chad gegs byed pa//sems can don la dman gyur pas/ /de yi ngan 'gro mu mtha' med/ /sems can gcig gi bde ba yang / /bshig na bdag nyid nyams 'gyur na/ /nam mkha' ma lus mtha' klas pa'i/ /lus can bde bshig smos ci dgos/ /de ltar ltung ba stobs ldan dang / /byang chub sems stobs ldan pa dag /'khor bar res kyis 'dre byed na/ /sa thob pa la yun ring thogs/ /de ltas ji ltar dam/ bcas bzhin/ /bdag gis gus par bsgrub par bya/ /deng nas brtson par ma byas na/ /'og nas 'og tu 'gro bar 'gyur/ /sems can thams cad phan mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas grangs med 'das gyur kyang / /bdag ni rang gi nyes pas de'i/ /gso ba'i spyod yul ma gyur to②/ /da dung de bzhin bdag byed na/ /yang dang yang du'ang de bzhin te/ /ngan 'gror nad dang 'ching ba dang / /bcad ②dang gsheg sogs myong bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang / /dad dang mi lus thob pa dang / /dge goms rung ba de lta gu④//dkon pa nam zhig thob par 'gyur/ /nad med nyi ma 'di lta bul/ /zas bcas 'tshe ba med kyang ni/ /tshe ni zhuskad cig bslu ba ste/ /lus ni ⑦thang cig brnyan po bzhin/ /bdag gi spyod pa 'di 'dras ni/ /mi yi lus kyang 'thob ⑤mi 'gyur/ /mi lus thob par ma gyur na/ /sdig pa 'ba' zhig dge ba med/ /gang tshe dge spyad skal ldan yang / /dge ba bdag gis ma byas na/ /ngan song sdug bsngal kun rmongs pa/ /de tshe bdag gis ci byar yod/ /dge ba dag kyang ma byas la/ /sdig pa dag kyang nyer bsags na/ /bskal pa bye ba brgyar 67da 966

yang ni/ /bde 'gro'i sgra yang thos mi 'gyur/ /de nyid phyir na bcom ldan gyis//rgya mtsho cher g.yengs gnya' shing gi/ /bu gar rus sbal mgrin chud ltar/ /mi nyid shin tu thob dkar gsungs/ /skad cig gcig byas sdig pas kyang / /bskal par mnar med gnas 'gyur na/ /thog med 'khor bar bsags sdig gis / /bde 'gror mi 'gro smos ci dgos/ /de tsam kho na myong gyur nas/ /de ni rnam thar mi 'gyur te/ /'di ltar de ni myong bzhin du/ /sdig pa gzhan dag rab tu skye/ /'di 'dra'i dal ba rnyed gyur nas/ /bdag gis dge goms ma byas na①/ /'di las bslus pa gzhan med de/ /'di las rmongs pa'ang gzhan med do/ /gal te bdag gis de rtogs nas/ /rmongs pas phyis kyang skyid lug na/ /'chi bar 'gyur ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /mya ngan chen po ldang bar 'gyur / /dmyal me bzod dkas dus ②ring du/ /bdag gi lus la bsregs gyur ⑤na/ /'gyod pa mi bzad me 'bar bas/ /sems gdung 'gyur ba ④gdon mi za/ /shin tu rnyed dka' phan pa'i sa/ /ji zhig ltar te brnyed gyur nas / /bdag nyid shes dang ldan bzhin du/ /phyir yang dmyal ba der khrid na / /sngags kyis rmongs par byas pa bzhin/ /bdag la 'dir sems med du zad/ /cis ⑥rmongs bdag kyang ma shes te/ /bdag gi khong na ci zhig yod//zhe sdang sred sogs dgra rnams ni/ /rkang lag la sogs yod min la/ /dpa' mdzangs min yang ji ④zhig ltar/ /de dag gis bdag bran bzhin byas/ /bdag gi sems la gnas bzhin du/ /dga' mgur ⑧bdag la gnod byed pa/ /de la'ang mi khro bzod pa ni/ /gnas min bzod pa smad pa'i gnas/ /gal te lha dang lha min rnams/ /thams cad bdag la dgrar langs kyang / /de 67—967

dag gis kyang mnar med pa'i/ /me nang khrid cing 'jug mi nus/ /nyon mongs stobs can dgra 'dis ni/ /gang dang phrad na ri rab kyang / /thal ba yang ni mi ①lus pa/ /der bdag skad cig gcig la 'dor/ /bdag gi nyon mongs dgra bo gang / /dus ring thog ②mtha' med pa ltar/ /dgra gzhan kun kyang de lta bur/ /yun ring thub ②pa ma yin no/ /mthun par rim gro bsten byas na/ /thams cad phan dang bde byed la⑦/ /nyon mongs rnams ni bsten byas na/ /phyir zhing sdug bsngal gnod pa byed/ /de ltar yun ring rgyun chags dgrar ⑤gyur pa/ /gnod pa'i tshogs rab 'phel ba'i rgyu gcig pu/ /bdag gi snying la nges par gnas 'cha' na/ /'khor bar 'jigs med dga' bar ga la 'gyur/ /'khor ba'i btson ra'i srung mas dmyal sogs su/ /gsod byed gshed mar gyur pa 'di dag ni/ /gal te blo gnas chags pa'i dra ba na/ /gnas na bdag la bde ba ga la yod/ /de ltar ①ji srid bdag gis dgra 'di mngon sum du/ /nges par ma bcom de srid bdag 'dir brtson mi 'dor/ /re zhig gnod byed chung ngu la yang khros gyur pa⑦/ /nga rgyal bdo rnams de ma bcom par gnyid mi 'ong / /rang bzhin 'chi bas dusdug bsngal gyur pa'i nyon mongs dag /g.yul ngor mdar 0tshe nan gyis gzhom par 'dod pa yang / /mda' mdung mtshon gyis phog pa'i sdug bsngal khyad bsad nas/ /don ma grub par phyir phyogs 'byer bar mi byed na/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal kun gyi rgyur gyur pa//rang bzhin dgra des ⑩gzhom brtson bdag la deng ⑪/ /sdug bsngal brgya phrag rgyur gyur gang gis kyang / /yi ⑫chad sgyid lug mi 'gyur smos ci dgos/ /don med dgra yis rma srol btod ⑩pa yang / /lus la rgyan ⑫dang 'dra bar srel byed 67—968

na① / /don chen sgrub ②phyir yang dag brtson gyur pa/ /bdag la sdug bsngal ci phyir gnod byed yin/ /nya pa gdol pa zhing pa la sogs pa/ /rang gi 'tsho ba tsam zhig sems pa yang / /grang dang tsha la sogs pa'i gnod bzod na/ /'gro ba bde phyir bdag lta cis mi bzod/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i/ /'gro ba nyon mongs las bsgral bar/ /dam bcas gang tshe bdag nyid kyang / /nyon mongs rnams las ma grol ba②/ /bdag gi tshod kyang mi shes par/ /smra ba ji ltar smyon pa min/ /de ltar ⑦nyon mongs gzhom pa la/ /rtag tu phyir mi ldog par bya/ /'di la bdag gis ⑤zhen bya zhing / /khon du bzung nas g.yul sprad de/ /rnam pa de 'dra'i nyon mongs pa/ /nyon mongs 'joms byed ma gtogs so/ /bdag ni bsregs ⑦te bsad gyur tam/ /bdag gi mgo bo bcad kyang bla'i/ /rnam pa kun du nyon mongs pa'i/ /dgra la 'dud par mi bya'o/ /tha mal dgra bo yul nas phyung yang ni/ /yul gzhan dag tu gnas shing yongs bzung nas/ /nus pa brtas ⑦nas de nas phyir ldog gi / /nyon mongs dgra tshul de dang 'dra ma yin/ /nyon mongs nyon mongs shes rab mig gis spang / /bdag yid las bsal gang du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gang du gnas nas bdag gnod bya phyir 'ong / /blo zhen bdag la brtson pa med par zad/ /nyon mongs rnams ni yul na mi gnas dbang tshogs dul min bar na'ang min/ /de las gzhan na'ang min na 'di dag gar gnas 'gro ba kun gnod byed/ /'di ni sgyu ⑨'dra de phyir snying la 'jigs spongs ⑩shes phyir brtson pa bsten/ /don med nyid du bdag la dmyal sogs rnams su ci ste gnod pa byed / /de ltar rnam bsams ji skad bshad pa yi/ /bslab pa bsgrub pa'i 67—969

ched du 'bad par bya/ /sman pa'i ngag ma mnyan ①na sman dag gis/ /bcos dgos nad pa sos pa ga la yod②/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las / bag yod bstan pa zhes bya ba ste le'u bzhi pa'o// //bslab pa bsrung bar 'dod pa yis/ /rab tu bsgrims nas sems bsrung ste / /sems 'di ②bsrung bar ma byas na/ /bslab pa bsrung bar yong ⑦mi nus / /sems kyi glang po yan btang bas/ /mnar med gnod pa byed pa ltar / /glang chen ma thul 8myos pa yis/ /'di na de 'dra'i gnod mi byed/ /kun nas dran pa'i thag pa yis/ /sems kyi glang po dam btags na/ /'jigs pa thams cad med 'gyur zhing / /dge ba thams cad lag tu 'ong / /stag dang seng ge glang chen dred/ /sbrul dang dgra rnams thams cad dang / /sems can dmyal ba'i srung ma dang / /byad ma de bzhin srin po rnams/ /sems 'di gcig pu btags pa yis/ /de dag thams cad btags par 'gyur//sems 'di gcig pu btul bas na/ /de dag thams cad thul ⑦bar 'gyur/ /'di ltar 'jigs pa thams cad dang / /sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa yang / /sems las byung ba yin no zhes/ /yang dag gsung ba nyid kyis bstan/ /sems can dmyal ba'i mtshon cha rnams/ /su zhig gis ni ched du byas/ /lcags sreg rgyas gzhi su yis byas/ /mo tshogs de dag ci las byung / /de 'dra de dag thams cad kyang / /sdig sems yin par thub pas gsungs/ /de ltar 'jig rten gsum po na/ /sems las 'jigs pa gzhan 'ga' med/ /gal te 'gro ba dbul bor nas/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin yin na/ /da rung ⑧'gro 61—970

bkren yod na sngon/ /skyob pa ji ltar pha rol phyin/ /bdog pa thams cad 'bras bcas te/ /skye bo kun la btang sems kyis/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin gsungs te/ /de ltas de ni sems nyid do①/ /nya la sogs pa gang zhig tu/ /de dag gsod mi 'gyur bar bskrad/ /spong ba'i sems ni thob pa las② /tshul khrims pha rol phyin par bshad/ /sems can mi srun ②nam mkha' bzhin/ /de dag gzhom gyis yong mi lang / /khro ba'i sems 'di gcig bcom na/ /dgra de thams cad choms dang 'dra/ /sa stengs ①'di dag kos g.yogs su⑦/ /de snyed ko bas ga la lang / /lham mthil tsam gyi ko bas ni/ /sa stengs ⑦thams cad g.yogs dang 'dra/ /de bzhin phyi rol dngos po yang / /bdag gis phyir bzlog mi lang gi/ /bdag gi sems 'di ⑦phyir bzlog bya'i/ /gzhan rnams bzlog go ci zhig dgos/ /sems gsal gcig bskyed ⑧'bras bu gang / /tshangs la sogs pa yin pa ltar/ /lus ngag bcas pa'i 'bras bu mang ⑨/ /spyod pa zhan pas de lta min/ /bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub kun//yun ring dus su spyad byas kyang / /sems gzhan g.yengs pas byas pa ni/ /de nyid rig pas don med gsungs/ /gang gis chos kyi gtso bo mchog /sems kyi gsang 'di ma shes na/ /bde thob sdug bsngal gzhom 'dod kyang / /de dag don med gyi nar 'khyam/ /de ltas bdag gi sems 'di ni/ /legs gzung ⑩legs par bsrung bar bya/ /sems bsrung brtul zhugs ma gtogs pa//brtul zhugs mang pos ci zhig bya/ /ma grangs drol ⑩ba'i khrod gnas na/ /sgrims kyite rma yi bag byed bzhin/ /skye bo ngan khrod gnas pas kyang / /sems kyi rma 'di rtag tu bsrung / /rma yi sdug bsngal chung ngu yis/ /skrag pa'ang rma yi 61—971

bag byed na/ / bsdus 'joms ris 'joms skrag pa dag① /sems kyi rma lta cis mi srung ②/ /spyod pa 'di 'dras gnas byed na/ /skye bo ngan pa'i khrod gnas sam/ /bud med khrod na gnas kyang rung / /sdom brtson brtan pa nyams mi 'gyur/ /bdag gi rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /lus dang 'tsho ba med bla zhing / /dge ba gzhan yang nyams bla yi/ /sems ni nams kyang nyams mi bya/ /sems bsrung 'dod pa rnams la ni/ /dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dag / thams cad 'bad pas ②srungs shig ces/ /bdag ni de ltar thal mo sbyor①/ /nad kyis dkrugs pa'i mi dag ni/ /las rnams kun la mthu med pa/ /de bzhin rmongs pas sems ⑤dkrugs pa/ /las rnams kun la mthu med do/ /shes bzhin med pa'i sems ldan pa'i/ /thos dang bsams ①dang bsgoms pa yang / /glo rdol bum pa'i chu bzhin du/ /dran pa la ni de mi gnas / /thos ldan dad pa can dang ni/ /brtson pa lhur rgyalen du ma yang / /shes bzhin med pa'i skyon chags pas/ /ltung ba'i rnyog dang bcas par 'gyur/ /shes bzhin med pa'i chom rkun dag /dran pa nyams pa'i rjes 'brang bas⑧/ /bsod nams dag ni nyer bsags kyang / /rkun pos phrogs bzhin ngan 'gror 'gro / /nyon mongs chom rkun tshogs 'di ni/ /glags skabs tshol bar byed pa ste/ /glags rnyed gyur nas dge 'phrog cing / /bde 'gro'i srog kyang 'joms par byed/ /de bas dran pa ⑨yid sgo nas/ /gud du nam yang mi gtong 8ngo / /song na'ang ngan 'gro ⑪gnod pa dag /dran par byas te nye bar bzhag⑫ /bla ma dang ni 'grogs pa las/ /mkhan pos rjes su brtan ⑩pa dang / /'jigs pas skal ldan gus byed la/ /dran pa bde blag nyid du skyedzo/ /67—972

sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dag /kun du thogs med gzigs par ldan//de dag thams cad spyan snga na/ / rtag par bdag ni ①gnas so zhes/ /de ltar bsams nas ngo tsha dang / / gus dang 'jigs ldan de bzhin gnos②/ /des na ②sangs rgyas rjes dran pa'ang / /de la yang dang yang du 'byung / /gang tshe dran pa ④yid sgo nas/ /bsrung ba'i don du gnas gyur pa/ /de tshe shes bzhin 'ong 'gyur zhing / /song ba dag kyang 'ong bar ①'gyur/ /re zhig dang po ①'di 'dra'i sems/ /'di ⑦ni skyon bcas shes byas nas/ /de tshe bdag gis shing bzhin du/ /zungs thub par ni gnas par bya/ /don med g.yeng bar lta ba ni/ /nam yang bdag gis mi bya ste/ /nges par sems pas rtag tu ni/ /mig ni phab ste blta bar bya/ /lta ⑧ba ngal bso'i 0ched du ni/ /res 'ga' ⑩phyogs su blta bar bya/ /'ga' zhig mig lam snang gyur na/ /bltas nas 'ongs pa legs zhes brjod/ /lam sogs 'jigs pa brtag pa'i phyir / /yang dang yang du phyogs bzhir lta7/ /ngal bsos 8kha ni phyir bltas nas / /rgyab kyi phyogs su blta bar bya/ /mdun dang 8rgyab tu brtag byas nas/ /'gro'am yang na 'ong bya ste/ /de ltar gnas skabs thams cad du/ /dgos pa shes nas spyad par bya/ /lus kyis 'di ltar gnas bya zhes/ /bya ba bsdogs nas de nas ni/ /skabs su lus 'di ji lta bur/ /gnas pa yin zhes blta bar bya/ /sems kyi glang chen myos pa ni/ /chos la sems pa'i ka ⑫chen la/ /ji ltar btags pa mi 'chor bar8/ /de ltar 'bad pa kun gyis brtagatso /ci nas ting 'dzin brtson pa ⑫ni/ /skad cig gcig kyang mi 'chor bar/ /bdag gi yid 'di gar spyod ces/ /de ltar yid la so sor brtag /'jigs 61—973

dang dga' ston sogs 'brel bar①/ /gal te mi nus ci bder bya/ /'di ltar sbyin pa'i dus dag tu/ /tshul khrims btang snyoms bya bar ②gsungs/ /gang zhig bsams te byar brtsams pa/ /de las gzhan du mi bsam ste/ /der gtang ba ②yi bsam pa yis/ /de nyid re zhig bsgrub par bya/ /de lta na ni kun legs byas/ /gzhan du gnyi gar ①mi 'gyur ro/ /shes bzhin ma yin nye nyon mongs/ /de lta na ni 'phel mi 'gyur/ /bre mo'i gtam ni sna tshogs dang //ngo mtshar ltad mo rnam mang po/ /kun la 'jug par gyur pa na/ /de la chags pa spang ① bar bya/ /don med sa rko rtswa gcod dang / /sa ris 'dri sogs byed gyur na/ /bde gshegs bslab pa dran byas nas/ /skrag pas de yi mod la dor/ /gang tshe bskyod par 'dod gyur ①tam/ /smra bar 'dod par gyur na yang / /dang por rang gi sems brtags nas/ /brtan pas rig ⑦pa ldan par bya/ /gang tshe rang yid chags pa dang / /khro bar 'dod pa de yi tshe/ /las su mi bya smra mi bya/ /shing bzhin du ni gnas par bya/ /dgod ⑧dang ga zhar bcas pa'am/ /gal te nga rgyal rgyags ldan pa'am/ /mtshang 'bru ⑨ba yi bsam pa dang / /gal te skyor 'byin slu sems sam/ /gang tshe bdag bstod lhur len pa'am/ /gzhan la smod pa nyid dang ni/ /gshe bcas 'gyod ⑩dang bcas gyur pa/ /de tshe shing bzhin gnas par bya/ /rnyed dang bkur sti grags 'dod pa'am/ /g.yog 'khor don du gnyer 'dod pa'am/ /bdag sems rim gro ⑪'dod gyur na/ /de tshe shing bzhin gnas par bya/ /gzhan don yal bar 'dor ba dang / /rang don gnyer bar 'dod pa dang ⑫/ /smra bar 'dod pa'i sems byung na/ /des ni shing bzhin gnas par bya /mi 67—974

bzod le lo 'jigs pa dang / /de bzhin spyi rtol ①nu cor dang / /rang gi phyogs zhen sems byung na/ /de tshe shing bzhin gnas par bya/ /de ltar kun nas nyon mongs dang / /don med brtson pa'i yid brtags nas/ /de tshe dpa' bos gnyen po yis/ /de ni brtan por gzung ②bar bya/ /shin tu nges dang rab dad dang / /brtan dang gus dang zhe sar bcas/ /ngo tsha shes dang 'jigs bcas dang ②/ /zhi zhing gzhan ①dga' byed la brtson/ /phan tshun mi mthun byis pa yi/ /'dod pa rnams kyis mi skyo zhing / /nyon mongs skyes pa ⑤'di dag gi/ /sems 'di byung snyam brtser ldan dang / /kha na ma tho med dngos la/ /bdag dang sems can dbang byas shing ①/ /sprul pa bzhin du nga med par/ /yid 'di rtag tu gzung bar bya/ /ring zhig lon nas dal ba'i mchog /thob pa yang dang yang bsams nas/ /sems de lta bur ri rab ⑦ltar / /rab tu mi g.yo gzung bar bya/ /bya rgod sha la chags pa yis/ /phan tshun kun du bshal khrid ⑧kyang / /yid ⑨khyod mi dgar mi byed na/ /da lta ci phyir kha ta byed/ /lus 'di bdag gir gzung byas nas/ /yid khyod ci phyir srung bar byed/ /khyod dang 'di gnyis so so na⑩/ /des ko khyod la ci zhig bya/ /rmongs pa'i yid khyod ci yi phyir/ /shing gzugs gtsang ma gzung mi byed—/ /mi gtsang tshogs kyi 'khrul 'khor 'di/ /rul ba bsrungs te ci zhig rung / /thog mar pags pa'i rim pa 'di/ /rang gi blo yis tha dad phye/ /sha yang rus pa'i dra ba las/ /shes rab mtshon gyis gud du phye/ /rus pa rnams kyang dbye byas nas/ /rkang gi bar du blta bya zhing / /'di la snying po ci yod ces—/ /bdag nyid kyis ni brtag par gyis/ /de ltar 'bad de btsal kyang 67—975

der / /khyod kyis snying po ma mthong na/ /da dung ci phyir chags tshul gyis/ /khyod ni lus 'di srung bar byed/ /khyod kyis mi gtsang bzar mi rung / /khrag kyang btung du mi rung la/ /rgyu lto'ang gzhib tu mi rung na/ /lus kyis khyod la ci zhig bya/ /nyis na wa dang bya rgod kyis①/ /zas kyi don du 'di bsrung rigs/ /mi 'o ②cog gi lus 'di ni/ /bkol bar bya ba nyid du zad/ /'di ltar khyod kyis bsrungs kyang ni/ /'chi bdag brtse ba med pa yis/ /phrogs te bya dang khyir byin na/ /de tshe khyod kyis ci byar yod/ /bran g.yog bkol du mi btub la'ang ②/ /gos la sogs pa mi sbyin na/ /lus 'di bsnyod kyang gzhan 'gro na//khyod ko ci ste ①sha thang gso/ /'di la gla rngan byin nas ni/ /da ni rang gi don byed chug /phan pa med par ⑦'di la ni/ /thams cad sbyin par mi bya'o/ /'gro dang 'ong ba'i rten tsam du/ /lus la gru yi blo bzhag ste/ /sems can rnams don bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /yid bzhin gyi ni lus su bsgyur/ /de ltar rang dbang yod kyis de①/ /rtag tu 'dzum pa'i bzhin du gyis/ /khro gnyer ngo zum yongs thong ste/ /'gro ba'i bshes dang gsong por gyis/ /khri la sogs pa bab col du/ /sgra dang bcas par mi dor ro/ /sgo yang drag tu mi dbye ste/ /rtag tu gcom bskyungs dga' bar bya/ /chu skyar byi la chom rkun dag /sgra med 'jab cing 'gro ba yis/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i don sgrub ⑦pa/ /thub pas rtag tu de bzhin spyad/ /gzhan la bzhen bskul ⑧'debs mkhas shing / /ma bcol phan pa ⑨byed pa'i ngag /gus pas spyi bos blang gyis 0te/ /rtag tu kun gyi slob mar gyur/ /legs par smas ⑪pa thams cad la/ /dge bar gsungs zhes brjod par bya/ /bsod nams byed pa mthong gyur na/ /bstod 67—976

pas legs par ①dga' ba bskyed/ /lkog na yon tan brjod bya zhing / /yon tan brjod na rjes su brjod/ /rang gi yon tan brjod na de②/ /yon tan shes par rig par bya/ /rtsom pa thams cad dga' phyir te/ /de ni rin gyis nyo na'ang dkon/ /de ltas ②gzhan byas yon tan gyis/ /dga' ba'i bde ba spyad par bya/ /bdag la 'dir gong yong med la/ /pha rol du ①yang bde ba che/ /nyes pas mi dga' sdug bsngal zhing / /pha rol du yang sdug bsngal che/ /smra na yid phebs 'brel pa dang / /don gsal yid du 'ong ba dang / /chags dang zhe sdang spangs pa dang / /'jam zhing ran par smra bar bya/ /mig gis sems can lta na yang / /'di dag nyid la brten nas bdag /sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ro zhes/ /drang zhing byams pa'i tshul gyis blta/ /rtag par mngon zhen gyis bslang ba'am/ /gnyen po ⑤yis ni bslang ba nyid/ /yon tan dang ni phan 'dogs zhing / /sdug bsngal ba ⑦la dge chen 'gyur/ /mkhas shing ldang ④dang ldan byas nas/ /las rnams bdag gis rtag tu byadu/ /las rnams kun la su la yang / /ltos ⑨par bya ba ma yin no/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin la sogs//gong nas gong du khyad zhugs spyad/ /chung ngu'i phyir ni che mi gtang ⑫/ /gtso cher gzhan gyi don bsam mo/ /de ltar rig byas gzhan don la/ /rtag tu brtson par ⑪gnas par bya/ /thugs rje ⑫mnga' ba ring gzigs pas/ /bkag pa rnams kyang de la gnang / /log par lhung dang mgon med dang / /brtul zhugs gnas la bgo bya zhing / /ran pa tsam du tshubaza' bya ste/ /chos gos gsum ma gtogs pa sbyin/ /dam pa'i chos ni spyod pa'i lus/ /phran tshegs ched du gnod mi bya/ /de ltar byas na sems can gyi/ /bsam pa myur 67—977

du rdzogs par 'gyur/ /snying rje'i bsam pa ma dag par/ /lus 'di gtang ①bar mi bya ste/ /ci nas 'di dang gzhan du yang / /don chen sgrub pa'i rgyur gtang ②ngo / /ma gus pa la chos mi bshad/ /mi na bzhin du mgo dkris dang //gdugs dang 'khar ②ba mtshon thogs dang / /mgo bo g.yogs pa dag la min/ /dman la zab dang rgya che dang / /skyes pa med par bud med min/ /dman dang mchog gi chos rnams la/ /mtshungs par gus pas ④kun du spyad/ /rgya chen chos kyi snod gyur pa/ /dman pa'i chos la sbyar mi bya/ / spyod pa yongs su dor mi bya/ /mdo dang sngags kyis 'drid mi bya⑤/ /so shing dang ni mchil ma dag /dor ba na ni dgab par bya/ /gci la sogs pa'ang longs spyod pa'i/ /chu dang thang la dor ba smad/ /kha bkang ba dang sgra bcas dang / /kha gdangs nas ni bza' ⑦mi bya/ /rkang pa brkyang ste mi 'dug cing / /lag pa mnyam par mi mnye'o/ /bzhon pa mal stan gnas dag tu/ /bud med gzhan dang gcig mi bya/ /'jig rten ma dad gyur ⑦pa kun/ /mthong dang dris te spang bar bya/ /sor mos brda ni mi bya ste/ /gus dang bcas pas ⑧g.yas pa yi/ /lag pa dag ni kun gyis kyang / /lam yang de ltar bstan par bya/ /lag pa shas cher bskyod min te/ /cung zad bskyod la sgra bsgrags pa/ /se gol la sogs brda byas te⑨/ /gzhan du ma bsdams ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /mgon po mya ngan 'das gzims ltar/ /'dod pa'i phyogs su nyal bar bya/ /shes bzhin myur du ldang sems la/ /thog ma nyid du nges par sbyar⑩/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dag /tshad med par ni gsungs pa las/ /sems sbyang ba yi spyod pa ni/ /nges par de srid spyad par bya/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum 61—978

du / /phung po gsum pa gdon bya zhing / /rgyal dang byang chub sems brten pas / /ltung ba'i lhag ma des zhi bya/ /rang ngam gzhan gyi dbang yang rung / /gnas skabs gang du ci spyod kyang / /bslab par gsungs pa gang yin pa'i/ /gnas skabs de la 'bad de bslab/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis ①mi bslab pa/ /de ni gang yang yod min te/ /de ltar gnas pa'i mkhas pa la/ /bsod nams mi 'gyur gang yang med/ /dngos sam yang na brgyud kyang rung / /sems can don las gzhan mi spyad/ /sems can kho na'i don gyi phyir/ /thams cad byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /rtag par dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni/ /theg chen don la mkhas pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i brtul zhugs mchog /srog gi phyir yang mi btang ②ngo / /dpal 'byung ba yi rnam thar las/ /bla ma bsten pa'i tshul ltar bslab/ /'di dang sangs rgyas bka' stsal gzhan/ /mdo sde bklags ②nas shes par bya/ /mdo sde rnams las bslab pa snang / /de bas mdo sde bklag ①par bya/ /nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo sde ni/ /thog ma nyid du blta bar bya/ /gang phyir rtag tu spyad pa ni/ /de las rgya cher rab ston pas / /bslab pa kun las btus pa yang / /nges par yang dang yang du blta / /yang na re zhig mdor bsdus pa'i/ /mdo rnams kun las btus pa blta/ /'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i⑤/ /gnyis po'ang ①'bad pas blta bar bya/ /gang las gang ni ma bkag pa/ /de nyid spyad par bya ba ste/ /'jig rten sems ni bsrung ba'i phyir/ /bslab pa mthong nas yang dag spyad/ /lus dang sems kyi gnas skabs la/ /yang dang yang du brtag bya ba/ /de nyid kho na mdor na ni/ /shes bzhin bsrung ba'i mtshan 67—979

nyid do/ /lus kyis ①'di dag spyad ②par bya/ /tshig tsam brjod pas ci zhig 'grub / /sman dpyad bklags pa tsam gyis ni/ /nad pa dag la phan 'gyur ram—/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ shes bzhin bsrung bar bya ba ②ste le'u lnga pa'o// //bskal pa stong du bsags pa yi/ /sbyin dang bde gshegs mchod la sogs//legs spyad gang yin de kun yang ①/ /khong khro gcig gis 'joms par byed/ /zhe sdang lta bu'i sdig pa med/ /bzod pa lta bu'i dka' thub med/ /de bas bzod la nan tan du/ /sna tshogs tshul du ⑤bsgom par bya/ /zhe sdang zug rngu'i sems 'chang na/ /yid ni zhi ba nyams mi myong / /dga' dang bde ba'ang mi 'thob la/ /gnyid mi 'ong zhing brtan med 'gyur/ /gang dag nor dang bkur sti yis/ /drin byin de la brten gyur pa/ /de dag kyang ni sdang ldan pa'i / /rje dpon de la gsod par rgol/ /de yis mdza' bshes skyo bar 'gyur—/ /sbyin pas bsdus kyang bsten ①mi byed/ /mdor na khro ba bder gnas pa/ /de ni 'ga' yang yod ma yin/ /khro ba'i dgra yis de la sogs/ /sdug bsngal dag ni byed par 'gyur/ /gang zhig bsgrims te khro 'joms pa/ /de ni 'di dang gzhan du bde/ /mi 'dod byas dang 'dod pa yi/ /gegs byas pa la byung gyur pa/ /yid mi bde ba'i zas rnyed nas/ /zhe sdang brtas ⑦te bdag 'joms so/ /de ltas bdag gis dudagra bo de'i/ /zas ni rnam par gzhom par bya/ /'di ltar bdag la gnod pa las/ /dgra 'di la ni las gzhan med/ /ci la bab kyang bdag gis ni/ /dga' ba'i yid ni dkrugs ⑨67da 980

mi bya/ /mi dga' byas kyang 'dod mi 'grub/ /dge ba dag ni nyams par 'gyur / /gal te bcos su yod na ni/ /de la mi dgar ci zhig yod/ /gal ①te bcos su med na ni②/ /de la mi dga' byas ci phan/ /bdag gam ②bdag gi bshes rnams la/ /sdug bsngal brnyas dang tshig rtsub dang / /mi snyan zhes bya mi 'dod de/ /dgra la de las bzlog pas so/ /bde ba'i rgyu ni res 'ga' 'byung / /sdug bsngal rgyu ni shin tu mang / /sdug bsngal med par nges 'byung med/ /de bas sems khyod brtan par mnos/ /dka' zlog ①dad dang /rna ⑤pa/ / bsreg dang bcad ①sogs tshor ba ni/ /don med bzod byed thar pa yi/ /don du bdag go ci phyir sngar/ /goms ni ⑦sla bar mi 'gyur ba'i/ /dngos de gang yang yod ma yin/ /de bas gnod pa chung goms pasal/ /gnod pa chen po ⑨bzod par byos/ /sbrul dang sha sbrang dag dang ni/ /bkres ⑩skom la sogs tshor ba dang / /g.yan pa la sogs bcas pa yi/ /don med sdug bsngal cis ma mthong / /tsha grang char dang rlung sogs dang / /nad dang 'ching dang rdeg ⑪sogs la/ /bdag gis bze ⑫re mi bya ste/ /de ltar byas na gnod pa 'phel/ /la la bdag gi khrag mthong na/ /dpa' brtan lhag par skye 'gyur yod/ /la la gzhan gyi khrag mthong na/ /bog ⑫cing brgyal bar 'gyur ba yod/ /de ni sems kyi ngang ④brtan dang / /sdar ma'i tshul las gyur pa yin/ /de bas gnod pa khyad bsad cing / /sdug bsngal rnams kyis mi tshugs byos/ /mkhas pas sdug bsngal byung yang ni/ /sems kyi rab dang rnyog mi bya/ /nyon mongs rnams dang g.yul 'gyed la/ /g.yul 'gyed tshe na gnod pa mang / /sdug bsngal thams cad khyad bsad nas/ /zhe sdang la sogs dgra 'joms pa/ /67—981

de dag rgyal byed dpa' bo ste/ /lhag ma ro la gsod pa'o/ /gzhan yang sdug bsngal yon tan ni/ /skyo bas dregs pa sel bar byed/ /'khor ba pa la snying rje skye/ /sdig la 'dzem ①dang dge la dga'/ /mkhris pa la sogs sdug bsngal gyi—/ /'byung gnas che la mi khro bar/ /sems yod rnams la ci ste khro/ /de dag kun kyang rkyen gyis bskul/ /dper na mi 'dod bzhin du yang / /nad 'di ②'byung bar 'gyur ba ltar/ /de bzhin mi 'dod bzhin du yang / /nan gyis nyon mongs 'byung bar 'gyur/ /khro bar bya zhes ma bsams kyang / /skye bo rnams ni gyi nar khro/ /bskyed par bya zhes ma bsams kyang / /khro ba de bzhin skye bar 'gyur/ /nyes pa ji snyed thams cad dang / /sdig pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa/ /de kun rkyen gyi stobs las byung / /rang dbang yod pa ma yin no//rkyen rnams tshogs pa de dag kyang / /bskyed par bya zhes sems pa med/ /des bskyed de yang bdag bskyed ②ces/ /sems pa yod pa ma yin no/ /gtso bo zhes byar ①gang 'dod dang / /bdag ces brtags pa gang yin pa/ /de nyid bdag ni 'byung bya zhes/ /ched du bsams shing 'byung ba med/ /ma skyes par ni de med na/ /de tshe skye bar 'dod pa gang / /yul la rtag tu g.yeng 'gyur ba⑤/ /'gag par 'gyur ba'ang ①ma yin no/ /ci ste bdag de rtag na ni / /mkha' bzhin byed pa med par mngon/ /rkyen rnams gzhan dang phrad na yang / /'gyur ba med la ⑦ci byar yod/ /byed pa'i tshe yang sngon bzhin na/ /byed pas ⑧de la ci zhig byasal/ /de yi byed pa 'di yin zhes/ /'brel par 'gyur ba gang zhig yod/ /de ltar thams cad gzhan gyi dbang / /de yi dbang gis de dbang med/ /de ltar shes na sbrul lta bu'i/ /dngos po kun la 67—982

khro mi 'gyur/ /gang gis gang zhig bzlog bya ste/ /bzlog pa'ang rigs pa min zhe na/ /de la brten nas sdug bsngal rnams/ /rgyun chad 'gyur 'dod mi rigs med/ /de bas dgra 'am mdza' yang rung / /mi rigs byed pa mthong gyur na/ /'di 'dra'i rkyen las gyur to zhes/ /de ltar soms ①te bde bar mnos / /gal te rang dgas 'grub 'gyur na/ /'ga' yang sdug bsngal mi 'dod pas/ /lus can dag ni thams cad kyang / /su la'ang sdug bsngal 'byung mi 'gyur/ /bag med pas ni bdag la'ang bdag /tsher ma la sogs gnod pa byed/ /bud med la sogs thob bya'i phyir/ /rngam zhing zas gcod la sogs byed/ /kha cig 'gag ②cing g.yang sar mchong / /dug dang mi 'phrod za ba dang / /bsod nams ma yin spyod pa yis/ /rang la gnod pa byed pa yod / /gang tshe nyon mongs dbang gyur pas/ /bdag sdug nyid kyang gsod byed pa②/ /de tshe de dag gzhan lus la/ /gnod mi byed par ji ltar 'gyur/ /nyon mongs skyes pas ⑦de lta bur/ /bdag gsod la sogs zhugs pa la/ /snying rje rgya ⑤la ma skyes na/ /khro bar 'gyur ba ci ⑦tha tshig /gal te gzhan la 'tshe byed pa/ /byis pa rnams kyi rang bzhin ni⑦/ /de la khro ba ⑧mi rigs te/ /sreg pa'i rang bzhin me bkon 'dra/ /'on te skyon de glo bur la/ /sems can rang bzhin des pa na'ang ⑨/ /'o na'ang khro ba ⑩mi rigs te/ /mkha' la dud ⑪'thul dkon pa bzhin/ /dbyug pa la sogs dngos bkol te/ /gal te 'phen pa la khro na/ /de yang zhe sdang gis sbad pas/ /nyes ⑫na zhe sdang la khro rigs / /bdag gis sngon chad sems can la/ /'di 'dra ba yi gnod pa byas / /de bas sems can 'tshe byed pa/ /bdag la gnod pa 'di 'byung 67—983

rigs / /de yi mtshon dang bdag gi lus/ / gnyi ga ༅sdug bsngal rgyu yin te//des mtshon bdag gi lus phyung na/ /gang zhig la ni khro bar bya/ /shu ba mi yi gzugs 'dra ba/ /reg tu mi bzod sdug bsngal can/ /sred mdongs ②bdag gis bzung gyur na/ /de la gnod pa su la khro/ /byis pa sdug bsngal mi 'dod cing / /sdug bsngal rgyu la brkam pas na/ /rang gi nyes pas gnod gyur pa②/ /gzhan la bkon du ci zhig yod/ /dper na dmyal ba'i srung ma dang / /ral gri lo ma'i nags tshal ltar/ /rang gi las kyis 'di bskyed pa④/ /gang zhig la ni khro bar bya/ /bdag gi las kyis ⑤bskul byas nas/ /bdag la gnod byed rnams 'byung ste/ /des ni ④sems can dmyal dong na/ /bdag gis de dag ma brlag ⑦gam/ /'di dag la ni rten ⑧bcas nas/ /bzod pas bdag sdig mang du 'byung / /bdag la brten nas de dag ni/ /yun ring sdug bsngal dmyal bar 'dong / /bdag ni de la gnod byed la/ /de dag bdag la phan 'dogs na/ /phyin ci log tu ci yi phyir/ /ma rungs sems khyod khro bar byed/ /gal te bdag la bsam pa yi/ /yon tan yod na dmyal mi 'gro/ /gal te bdag gis bdag bsrungs na/ /de dag la 'dir ci zhig byung ⑨/ /'on te lan du gnod byas na/ /de dag bsrungs par ma gyur la/ /bdag gi spyod pa'ang nyams par 'gyur/ /des na dka' thub zhig par 'gyur/ /yid ni lus can ma yin pas/ /sus kyang gang du'ang gzhom mi nus/ /lus la mngon par zhen pas na/ /lus ni ⑩sdug bsngal dag gis gnod/ /brnyas dang tshig rtsub smra ba dang / /mi snyan pa yi tshig de yis/ /lus la gnod par mi 'gyur na//sems khyod ci phyir rab tu khro/ /gzhan dag bdag la mi dga' ba/ /desani 67—984

tshe 'di'am tshe gzhan la/ /bdag la za bar mi byed na/ /bdag ni ci phyir de mi 'dod/ /rnyed pa'i bar chad byed pa'i phyir/ /gal te 'di bdag mi 'dod na| /bdag gi rnyed pa 'dir ①'dor gyi/ /sdig pa dag ni brtan par gnas/ /bdag ni deng nyid shi yang bla'i/ /log 'tshos ②yun ring gson mi rung / /bdag lta yun ring gnas gyur kyang / /'chi ba'i sdug bsngal de nyid yin/ /rmi lam lo brgyar bde myong nas/ /sad par gyur pa gang yin dang / /gzhan zhig yud tsam bde myong nas/ /sad par gyur pa gang yin pa/ /sad pa de dag gnyi ga la'ang / /bde ba de ni phyir 'ong med/ /tshe ring tshe thung gnyi ga yang / /'chi ba'i dus su ②de 'drar zad/ /rnyed pa mang po thob gyur te/ /yun ring dus su bde spyad kyang / /chom pos phrogs pa ji bzhin du/ /sgren mo lag pa stong par 'gro/ /gal te rnyed pas gson gyur na/ /sdig zad bsod nams bya zhe na/ /rnyed pa'i don du khros gyur na/ /bsod nams zad sdig mi 'gyur ram/ /gang gi don du bdag gson pa/ /de nyid gal te nyams gyur na//sdig pa 'ba' zhig byed pa yi/ /gson pa des ko ci zhig bya/ /gal te sems can nyams byed pas/ /mi snyan smra la khro zhe na/ /gzhan la mi snyan brjod la'ang khyod/ /de bzhin ci ste khro mi byed/ /ma dad gzhan la rag las pas/ /dad pa med la khyod bzod na/ /nyon mongs skye la rag las pas①/ /mi snyan smra la cis mi bzod/ /sku gzugs mchod rten dam chos la/ /'khyal zhing 'jig par byed pa la'ang / /bdag gis zhe sdang mi rigs te/ /sangs rgyas sogs la gnod mi mnga'/ /bla ma gnyen la sogs pa dang / /bshes la gnod pa byed rnams la'ang / /snga ma'i tshul gyis rkyen dag las/ /'gyur bar 67—985

mthong nas khro ba bzlog /lus can rnams la sems yod dang / /sems med gnyi gas gnod byas ①na/ /sems yod ci ste bkar te bkon/ /de bas gnod pa bzod par gyis/ /la la rmongs pas nyes pa byed/ /la la rmongs te khros gyur na/ /de la skyon med gang gis bya/ /skyon dang bcas te gang zhig yin/ /gang gis gzhan dag gnod byed pa'i/ /las de sngon chad ci phyir byas/ /thams cad las la rag las na/ /bdag gis 'di la ci ste bkon//de ltar mthong nas ci nas kyang / /thams cad phan tshun byams sems su/ /'gyur ba de ltar bdag gis ni/ /bsod nams dag la bsgrims te bya/ /dper na khyim tshig gyur pa'i me/ /khyim gzhan zhig tu song nas ni/ /rtswa sogs gang la mched byed pa/ /de ni phyung ste dor ba yin/ /de bzhin gang la sems chags na②/ /zhe sdang me ni mched gyur pa/ /bsod nams tshig par dogs pa yis/ /de ni de yi mod la dor/ / gsad bya'i ③mi zhig lag bcad de / /gal te thar na cis ma legs/ /gal te mi yi sdug bsngal gyis/ /dmyal ba bral na cis ma legs/ /da lta'i sdug bsngal 'di tsam la'ang / /bdag gis bzod par mi nus na/ /des na dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu/ /khro ba ci ste bzlog mi byed/ /'dod pa'i don du sreg ①la sogs/ /dmyal bar stong phrag myong ①gyur yang / /bdag gis rang gi don dang ni/ /gzhan gyi don yang ma byas so/ /'di ni de tsam gnod min ①la/ /don chen dag kyang 'grub 'gyur bas/ /'gro ba'i gnod sel sdug bsngal la/ /dga' ba 'ba' zhig 'dir bya rigs/ /gzhan gyis ⑦yon tan ldan bstod nas/ /gal te dga' ba'i bde thob na/ /yid khyod kyang ni de bstod nas/ /ci phyir de ltar dga' 67—986

mi byed/ /khyod kyi dga' ba'i bde ba 'di/ /bde 'byung kha na ma tho med/ /yon tan ldan pa rnams kyis gnang / /gzhan sdud pa yi mchog kyang yin/ /gzhan yang de ltar bde 'gyur zhes/ /gal te khyod bde 'di mi 'dod/ /gla rngan ①sbyin sogs spangs pa'i phyir/ /mthong dang ma mthong nyams par 'gyur / /rang gi yon tan brjod pa'i tshe/ /gzhan la bde ba'ang ②'dod par byed/ /gzhan gyi yon tan brjod pa'i tshe/ /rang la'ang bde ba mi 'dod byed/ /sems can thams cad bde 'dod pas/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed nas/ /sems can rang gis bde rnyed na/ /des ②ko ci ste khro bar byed/ /'jig rten gsum mchod 'tshang rgya bar/ /sems can rnams ni 'dod ce na/ /bsnyen bkur ngan ngon tsam mthong nas/ /ci ①phyir de la gdung bar byed/ /gso bya gang zhig khyod ⑦gso ba/ /khyod nyid kyis ni sbyin bya de/ /gnyen gyis ①'tsho ba rnyed gyur na/ /dgar mi 'gyur bar slar khro'am/ / de ci ⑦'gro la mi 'dod na/ /de la byang chub 'dod gang yin//gang zhig gzhan 'byor khro de la/ /byang chub sems ni ga la yod/ /gal te des de las ⑧rnyed dam/ /sbyin bdag khyim na gnas gyur pa/ /kun du de khyod la med na/ /byin ma byin rung des ci bya/ /bsod nams dang ni dad pa'am/ /rang gi yon tan ci phyir 'dor/ /rnyed pa ⑨gyur pa mi 'dzin pa⑫/ /gang gis khro ba ⑪mi byed smros/ /khyod ni rang gis sdig byas la/ /mya ngan med par ma zad kyi/ /bsod nams byas pa gzhan dag dang / /lhan cig 'gran par byed 'dod dam// //bam po gnyis pa'o⑩/ /gal te dgra zhig mi dga' na'ang / /de la khyod 61—987
